bugs.title: Purchase Order creation requires a delivery branch that the form does not let the user select
steps: Sign in to Nexstock QA Company and open Purchase Orders > New Purchase Order.
Select an active isolated QA supplier (QA P2 Vendor mvo2d41l) and QA add mv9rtxw1-3b087e.
Enter quantity 4, unit cost Rs 25, tax Rs 10, discount Rs 5 and shipping Rs 2; total Rs 107.
Set currency MUR, a future expected delivery date and a QA note.
Inspect the form for a delivery branch or warehouse selector, then click Create Purchase Order.
bugs.expected: The user can select the destination branch and save a valid draft PO for subsequent approval, receipt and PDF export.
bugs.actual: No delivery branch/warehouse input is present and the form submits no branchId. The server rejects creation with HTTP 422 validation_failed: data.branchId = Choose the branch the goods are delivered to. All six independent/full-flow cases reproduce the same prerequisite failure.
bugs.comment: Add a destination branch selector backed by active company branches, send its branchId and retain/display the delivery location. Then rerun PO lifecycle/export/fulfillment, GRN and PO-linked billing. Do not log duplicate downstream receipt, status or PDF defects before they become reachable.
